name: Raptor Ridge
summary: Raptor Ridge rises above the eastern Wetlands, northwest of the Dragonmaw Gates. Razormaw raptors hunt and nest among its crags, with a vicious matriarch deep in the caverns.

sections.title: A Den of Predators
sections.body: Razormaw raptors hunt in packs across Raptor Ridge, where rocky trails climb above the eastern Wetlands. Travelers near the foothills of Khaz Modan risk meeting these predators. In a cavern at the ridge's heart, the Razormaw Matriarch guards her brood and nests from intruders. The Dragonmaw Gates lie close by.

aliases: how to get to raptor ridge
faq.answer: Raptor Ridge rises in the far eastern Wetlands, directly northwest of the Dragonmaw Gates on the road toward Grim Batol.

aliases: what mobs are at raptor ridge
faq.answer: Razormaw raptors roam the ridge. Deep in its cavern, the Razormaw Matriarch guards her nests and hatchlings.
The Razormaw Matriarch leads the local raptor packs and broods over her clutch in the ridge's central cave.

faq.q: Why is the area so dangerous to traverse?
faq.answer: Dense packs of aggressive, fast-moving raptors swarm trespassers. The ridge also lies in the shadow of hostile Dragonmaw orc territory near the mountain passes.

angles.text: As a hunter, you can seek a swift, tenacious marshland companion among the fierce Razormaw raptors of the ridge.
